summary_zh: 今日越南華商製造業重點：北寧省兩大工業園區突擊檢查11家企業，8家因環境違規遭罰逾11億越南盾，減碳與環保合規壓力持續升溫。香港Biel Crystal再投資近5億美元擴建海防廠，國會同時審議投資法、企業所得稅法修正草案，影響在越投資與稅務規劃。關稅調整議題亦持續升溫。
summary_en: Bac Ninh inspected 11 firms in two industrial parks; 8 were fined over VND1.1bn for environmental violations, raising compliance pressure. Biel Crystal adds ~US$500m in Hai Phong, and the National Assembly is reviewing Investment and CIT law amendments. Tariff concerns keep rising.
